recent.name: PRHawk
recent.description: 🦅 AI-powered GitHub PR reviewer — paste a pull request URL to get inline comments, a quality score, and a merge recommendation posted   ▎ back to GitHub. Learns each team's coding conventions from merged PR history. React + Express + better-auth.
